messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
another person insists their job is more urgent than yours while you are handling A shared tray of spare parts. Both people are waiting for you to respond. How do you approach it?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R025", "response": "I lean closer, then tap the tray with a knuckle. ‘I’m not saying it’s finished yet,’ I say, keeping the spare parts beside the shared tray. I tap again, then lean again. ‘I mark the scratch on the spare, leave it where it is, and wait for your turn.’"}, {"id": "R026", "response": "I tap the spare parts on the tray and count them twice before turning them. I keep them beside the bench, but I push one away and tap the same empty slot with my hand. I leave the tray beside the bench and wait until the same hand returns."}, {"id": "R027", "response": "1. slow. 2. check the watch. slow. 3. ask the other one: \"wait. 4. check the spare parts. 5. check the tray. 6. i keep it tidy.\" 7. reply. \"yes. check the tray. 8. i will check the spare parts. 9. check your watch. slow.\""}, {"id": "R028", "response": "i touch the spare part. i look at the tray. i put the part beside the other. the person waits. i move the tray once. the part stays. i put the spare part in the step. the two things stay together."}, {"id": "R029", "response": "i tap the tray twice with my fingertip, then lean against the wall. “sure,” i say, and tap the spare part three times. “one wrong word makes it mine.” i hold the tray up with both hands and tap the spare part twice against the wall."}, {"id": "R030", "response": "\"Urgent. Likely.\" You check the watch, then the tray. \"Spare parts first. Likely.\" You turn back, but the watch ticks again."}, {"id": "R031", "response": "i move the tray slowly and wait. i keep the spare parts in my hand for later. i keep the other person’s hand still on theirs until they come back."}, {"id": "R032", "response": "i leave the spare parts on the tray and mark the spot where the other person’s hand left the dirty one. i wait for the other person’s wrist to move, then i touch the tray with a grease-pencil mark. if the other person keeps their hand on the spare, i leave the mark; if they move, i keep the dirty part."}, {"id": "R033", "response": "i say the tray’s name first, then my hand stays where it is. i leave the spare parts in the same place, then ask whether they are ready. if they are, i ask whether i should leave the name on the tray. if i do not, i leave the parts in the place they are."}, {"id": "R034", "response": "i turn my head. i say, “i want the spare. i wait.” i tap the tray with my greasy thumb. “urgent,” i say. i leave the parts on the table. “one piece, two people.”"}, {"id": "R035", "response": "i rub my palm and say, \"i put the spare parts in the tray, not you. i wait for you to move them, not to judge me. i mark the dirty part on the bench and leave it there. if you move it, i will finish it and call it urgent."}, {"id": "R036", "response": "I take the spare part. “slow. my hand goes over my mouth.” the person takes it first. i put the tray in my pocket and wait for their hand to move. if they move, i know the job is urgent."}]
